ad_info.reference_style: Christmas seasonal supplement ad with a model holding the bottle, benefit icons, a seal on the bottle, a mini before/after, a gift and a bottom pill bar

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents. Christmas red and green only in the scene props.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement Christmas ad: ultra-photorealistic woman with a Santa hat in a cozy living room, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Festive, warm, feminine and confident; warm tree lights and soft daylight.
global_identity.graphic_language: Hot fuchsia circles with thin white line icons, small rounded photo panels with pill labels and a curved arrow, a round seal, handwritten script accents with small hearts, a fuchsia rounded pill bar at the bottom.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (heavy, uppercase) for the headline, Poppins Regular for supporting text, casual handwritten script for the accents.

creative_objective: Turn the purchase into a Christmas gift for herself: the figure she dreams of, with a visible but natural gain in volume.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The woman with the Santa hat on the left. 2) The headline top-right ('REGÁLATE'). 3) The bottle with its seal. 4) Icons, mini before/after, gift tag, script and bottom bar.
art_direction.composition_style: Left 50%: the woman kneeling in 3/4 rear view on a white fluffy rug, looking over her shoulder, holding the bottle up near her face, Christmas tree and gifts behind. Top-right: script line, giant word, second line and a two-line subtitle. Middle-right: a column of four icons left of the large bottle with a round seal at its upper right. Lower-right: mini before/after panels. Bottom-right corner: a gift box with a hanging tag. Left edge, middle: a script accent. Bottom center: a pill bar.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Woman 0-55% width, 0-95% height. Headline block 4-30% height on the right 55%. Icon column 50-68% width, 33-65% height. Bottle 68-95% width, 35-75% height; seal over its upper-right edge. Mini before/after 50-72% width, 65-87% height. Gift with tag 82-100% width, 78-95% height. Script accent 0-18% width, 45-60% height. Bottom pill bar 37-82% width, 93-99% height.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Warm bokeh from the tree lights, soft daylight on the woman, glossy highlight on the bottle, soft shadows on the rug.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Cozy living room with a decorated Christmas tree and wrapped gifts on the left and a white fluffy rug. Left half: a woman kneeling in 3/4 rear view wearing a Santa hat, a red top and short white shorts with a red bow, holding the bottle up, looking at camera over her shoulder. Top-right: a script line, a giant bold word, a bold uppercase line and a two-line subtitle with a heart. Middle-right: four circular icons with short text in a column, and the bottle large to their right with a round seal. Lower-right: a mini before/after of two small rounded photos with labels and a curved arrow, a few capsules next to the bottle. Bottom-right: a gift box with a handwritten tag. Left edge: a handwritten script phrase with a heart. Bottom: a rounded pill bar with white uppercase text and a heart. A brand logo in the top-right corner (omitted).

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium Christmas supplement ad in a cozy living room: a decorated Christmas tree with warm lights and red and gold ornaments on the left, wrapped red and gold gifts at its base, a white fluffy rug on the floor, warm bokeh, pale blush walls. LEFT HALF: an ultra-photorealistic Latina woman in her mid 20s with long straight dark hair and a red Santa hat, kneeling on the rug in a 3/4 rear view, looking at the camera over her shoulder with a soft smile, wearing a red bralette-style top and very short fitted white ribbed shorts with a small red bow, red and white knit socks; she holds the product up near her face with one hand. Her glutes are full, round and lifted and her thighs toned, with natural, believable volume. Maximum realism: real skin texture with visible pores, natural creases, subtle skin tone variation, realistic fabric texture, real photo quality; no plastic or airbrushed skin; tasteful, non-explicit styling. TOP-RIGHT: a black handwritten script line, below it a giant bold uppercase word in hot fuchsia (#E6177F), below it a bold uppercase line in black, and a two-line subtitle in dark gray Poppins Regular ending with a small fuchsia heart. MIDDLE-RIGHT: a column of four hot fuchsia circles with thin white line icons (a rounded glutes silhouette, legs, a sparkle, a leaf), each with short two-line dark gray text to its right; to the right of the column, large: the product. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product, and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern and a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth; black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS'. The same bottle appears in the woman's hand. Over the bottle's upper-right edge, a round deep magenta (#B0105E) seal with a thin gold ring and white bold text. A few glossy fuchsia capsules next to the bottle base. LOWER-RIGHT: two small rounded photo panels side by side of the same woman's glutes from behind in short shorts: left in gray shorts, flatter; right in pink shorts, clearly fuller and rounder but natural; a small white curved arrow between them; a gray pill label above the left one and a fuchsia pill label above the right one. BOTTOM-RIGHT CORNER: a red gift box with a red satin bow and a hanging cream paper tag with black handwritten text. LEFT EDGE, middle, over the tree: white handwritten script text in four lines with a small heart. BOTTOM: a hot fuchsia rounded pill bar with white bold uppercase text and a small white heart. Include only these elements and texts.
